# The Vibe Suite

> getvibe.dev is the hub for The Vibe Suite — ten local-first, one-command companions for agentic coding CLIs like Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini. Your machine, your keys.

## What it is

The Vibe Suite is getvibe.dev is the hub for The Vibe Suite — ten local-first, one-command companions for agentic coding CLIs like Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini. Your machine, your keys..

## Platforms

- No platforms listed.

## Plans

- No plans listed.

## Free tools

- [viberadio](https://getvibe.dev/viberadio): Narrate your agent session as audio.
- [vibemovie](https://getvibe.dev/vibemovie): Turn a session into a recap video.
- [vibelive](https://getvibe.dev/vibelive): Multiplayer terminals for your agent.
- [vibeshare](https://getvibe.dev/vibeshare): Share a live session.
- [vibedonate](https://getvibe.dev/vibedonate): Collect support for your work.
- [vibedate](https://getvibe.dev/vibedate): A companion for your agent.
- [vibeads](https://getvibe.dev/vibeads): Contextual tool discovery.
- [vibenotifications](https://getvibe.dev/vibenotifications): Get notified on session events.
- [vibebrand](https://getvibe.dev/vibebrand): Tokenized brand/design system — CSS design tokens, fonts, and a brand kit.
- [vibecodereview](https://getvibe.dev/vibecodereview): A council of AI models reviews your PR.

## Common questions

Q: What is The Vibe Suite?
A: Ten local-first, one-command companions for agentic coding CLIs like Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini.

Q: How do I install a tool?
A: Each tool installs with a single npx command and runs next to your agent CLI — no dashboard, no cloud account.
